problems.note: Guess from the photos: the blue line on the right of face 3 looks like it rounds the arete to the blue hold on face 4.
Guess. Might continue onto face 2 around the left arete. · F2 contributes only the blue sloper on the F2/F3 arete (visible on both photos); merge with the F3 holds of this problem. Medium confidence.

FINISH tag beside the black hold. The rest of the line is on face 3 or 5 (not labelled yet).

Guess. Two red lines share this face; the split between them is unverified. · Merged with jawa-red-f8-b: Guess. Probably continues onto face 9 or 7. · F7 part of the red line: FINISH tag under the big red blob; faded-red pinches and the mid red cone lead up to it. Start is presumably F8's big red cone (outside this frame), so reused the F8 id. Low-medium confidence the mid cone belongs to this line vs a separate red problem.

START tag by the lower green pair, tag by the top green. Fairly confident. · Dark-green line: green square (two tags, likely START) -> curved green -> donut under triangle -> long sloper -> FINISH-tagged green top. These holds sit in the F7/F8 overlap so reused F8 id. Medium confidence; small dark-green dots assumed feet/intermediates. · Merged with jawa-green-f7: Mint/teal small holds, a lighter shade than the dark greens; possibly its own circuit. No tags seen. Low confidence.

White line on the arete; most of it is on face 9. · F1 part of the white arete line (continues up onto F9 / the F9-F1 arete). f1-white-edge (1 START tag) and f1-white-big (2 START tags) are the starts; the two small white holds low on the left are probably its feet. f1-grey-left-arete (silver, on the arete) is a low-confidence guess. Medium confidence. · Cross-face: starts on F1 (f1-white-edge, f1-white-big, START tags per F1 labeller), then F8 (f8-white-mid logo hold, f8-white-top curved pair). FINISH tag beside f9-white-top: fairly confident it is the finish. f9-white-low (floor, no tag) is a guess as a foot; it is very likely the same physical hold as F1's f1-white-bottom-edge (seen obliquely from F1) - keep only one when merging.

Three peach/orange holds: two on the grey triangle volume and one high near the top with an unreadable tag (assumed FINISH). No START tag seen, so the start is a guess. All three sit just right of the F1/F2 arete and also appear in the F2 photo; check the F2 labels for duplicates. Low-medium confidence. · FINISH tag under the orange hold top-left. Lower holds are on the grey corner volume; the start is probably on F1 (orange holds/volume at F1's right side), so this line likely crosses the corner from F1. Pale hold on the volume is a colour guess. Low-medium confidence.

Only one light grey/white hold on the orange pyramid, with two START tags under it. No other white holds nearby, so this may be a volumes-only line, a different grade colour, or part of jawa-white-f8. Low confidence.

Two dark grey pyramids low on the F1/F2 arete; one has a red insert. No tags seen, so the starts are a guess. There are no other black holds on F1, so the line probably goes onto F2 or uses the purple prism, which has a START tag on its tip. Low confidence.

START tags under the chalked pinch and the lower big blob; tagged purple top-right taken as finish. Small purples as feet/intermediates, horseshoe as a mid hold. Could be two purple lines (big-blob line vs horseshoe line); medium confidence.
Tags under the red blob (start) and FINISH tag at the tiny red crimp up top. Only 2 red holds visible on F2; middle may use F1 holds near the corner or be hidden. Low-medium confidence.

FINISH tag by the mint crimp top-centre. Green blocks and mint holds grouped together; start probably on F3 (tagged mint crimp f3-green-crimp just right of the arete) or the small green by the purple start. Mint vs darker green blocks may be two lines. Low confidence.

START tag under the black knob on the purple volume; the black hold just round the arete on F6 also carries a START-style tag, so this looks like a two-hand start split across the arete with the rest of the line on F6. Not linked to jawa-black-f4 (no black holds between here and the top-left of F4). Low-medium confidence; knob colour could be dark purple. · Split start across the arete: f5-black-knob (START tag below it) and the black hold just round the arete on F6's plane (START-style tags). No other black holds seen in the gap; rest of the line not identified. Medium confidence on the start pairing.

Pale mint crimp with START tag. Nothing else this colour on F5; it probably continues left onto F4 to the pale mint crimps (f4-green-crimp-1, f4-green-crimp-top with FINISH tag) that are currently in jawa-green-f4 with the bright green rails. Worth checking whether those are two different lines. Low confidence.

Fragment: adds only the red kidney. It has no FINISH tag (jawa-red-f6 already finishes on the FINISH-tagged small red crimp), so it is taken as an intermediate hand hold up-left of the red bowl start. Low confidence: it could belong to a different red line. · START tag on lower-left of the red bowl; FINISH tag on the tiny red crimp top-left. Only one intermediate red (small hold on purple pyramid) visible, so volumes are presumably in play. Low-medium confidence. The red bowl sits at the F5-side corner; may relate to the red kidney on the panel left of the F6 frame (F5 anchor).

White (red-capped) hold with a START tag under the upper purple spike. No other white holds in the gap; the line presumably continues right onto F6 (f6-white-* holds there are unassigned). Low confidence on colour (could count as red).

Two START tags (plus a small symbol tag) under the big blue = matched start; FINISH tag beside the top blue. Low blues (banana near floor, blue on lower grey volume, blue on centre grey volume) taken as feet of the same line. Medium confidence for start/finish, low for whether the low blues are a separate problem. · Two blue holds on the left frame edge; part of a blue line on F6. Low confidence.
Matching pale lilac-white round knobs; bottom one on the purple volume has a tag (likely START). Could be a light-purple set. No finish seen; may continue onto F6 (left). Low-medium confidence.

START-tagged orange/white hold; likely continues right onto F8's orange holds (finish there). Orange under the red cone assumed same set. Low confidence. · Merged with jawa-orange-f8: Guess. Tags by the pyramid orange and the top orange.

Mauve purple holds scattered across the face; pyramid near green square has a tag (unreadable). Likely continues onto F6 (top-left edge hold). Low confidence. · Merged with jawa-purple-f6: FINISH tag left of the top purple; a small tag on the little purple hold on the lower-right purple volume read as START. Big gap between the centre grey volume and the finish, presumably via the purple pyramid / grey volumes. Low confidence. The start sits on a volume that F7's anchor frames centrally, so the line may start from or share holds with F7.

START tag on the black crescent: confident start. Rest is a guess: crescent -> arete dot -> big black on the F9/F1 arete -> small black crimps, with grey arete feet. Probably also uses F8's unassigned f8-black-right / f8-black-low and F1's jawa-black-f1-a holds (f1-black-left-arete, f1-black-low-edge), which the F1 labeller said likely belong to an F9 black line - consider merging jawa-black-f1-a into this. Finish assumed f9-black-top (highest black, unreadable tag beside it): medium-low confidence. Overall low-medium confidence. · Two small black holds on the F9/F1 arete. They most likely belong to a black line on F9 (F9 has other black holds near the arete). Low confidence.
